text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. The period of intensive training
had arrived, where many Umamusume dedicate themselves to special workouts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whatever she was thinking, Neo Universe
stared intently at an Umamusume eating yakisoba—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Do you want to eat it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe cannot eat it.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because my "premolar" hurts.
choice_data_list: Wait, don't tell me... a cavity!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised. Neo Universe having a cavity...
I could never have imagined her getting something like that...
choice_data_list: Then let's go get you checked out!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A medical checkup...
I'm guessing "NOST"...

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text: Here, say 'ahh.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “AUHN”？　“AUHN”……。

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text:
There's... not a single cavity.
And your teeth are aligned so beautifully...

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text:
It might just be a bit of hypersensitivity.
It doesn't seem to require medical treatment.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "NOST"... Just as I thought...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They found no cavities at all, and the visit ended with praise for my well-aligned teeth.
Then what's causing the pain...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Phantom limb pain"...
Phantom pain, right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A pain that shouldn't be there—
is being "recalled."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"This pain will not subside.
What will subside is—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Once enough time passes. It'll settle down by the time the Kikuka Sho arrives, so until then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand it at all.
Yet, Neo Universe seems to.
If so...
choice_data_list: Do I just have to endure it for a while?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. Yes.
More importantly, Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to go.
Beyond... the door of summer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""RXIL"...
Do not mind the "trivialities"."
